Every time that I try to type out something, I usually fat-thumb it and have a ton of punctuation errors. There's just so much frustration, and it takes so much time to write a message. I'm definitely excited about using the phone app and everything within Wispr Flow to help me out, create emails, and practice speaking.

I think the important thing is practicing speaking into my phone and hearing my voice overall and having it make sense so I can get the message across. Overall, I feel the frustration subside because of this.
